args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 – Combined Summary (Tamarack)
args.body:
- Autonomous carts raised warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026.
- Integration took about twice as long as planned, so expect delays when rolling them out.
- According to the companion piece, the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks (fewer picking errors).

Sources: https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse ; https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion (public version, not the registered full version)
